score_note: Priorities are expected-information-value proxies only. They rank which evidence-gathering action is worth doing next; they are not gameplay quality scores or calibrated information gain.

actions.label: Semantic map-gameplay review

when.reason: map gameplay semantic gate is still unknown

actions.execution_hint: Review runtime screenshots/behavior or run the smallest semantic smoke needed to prove actual map gameplay; do not promote mechanical window evidence alone.

actions.label: Progression/economy evidence repair

when.reason: progression evidence is absent or incomplete

actions.execution_hint: Re-run/diagnose the engine-specific progression probe before attempting any grind calibration inference.

actions.label: Grind-vector gap diagnosis

when.reason: normalized grind vector is not fully ready

actions.execution_hint: Inspect missing_core_inputs and repair only measurable evidence gaps; do not invent a grind score.

actions.label: Sidequest/ending semantic review
actions.execution_hint: Review graph candidate clusters and terminal signals with semantic evidence. Preserve candidate vs verified counts.

actions.label: Collect baseline completion calibration labels
actions.execution_hint: If a baseline no-cheat/no-speedup main-story completion is actually performed, record hours and grind labels under the v0.7 calibration schema. Never infer a direct label from static features.

actions.label: Historical reputation evidence
actions.execution_hint: Recover dated player-rating/vote/download evidence with source provenance; keep historical reputation separate from AI structural prediction.

actions.label: Personal-fit decision label
actions.execution_hint: Add a user-specific fit label only when enough evidence exists; do not present it as a universal game-quality rating.
